question: __________ is calculated on the distance travelled which is given to meet the cost of a particular journey.
A Government servant on transfer may be given ______ of his last month's basic pay as composite transfer grant and packing grant.
Daily allowance may not be drawn for any day on which a Government servant does not reach a point outside a radius of __________ kilometres from the duty point at his headquarters.
There are _________ kinds of travelling allowances.
In case a Government servant in Pay Level 10 is transferred from one station to another in the interest of public services, the rate of transportation of personal effects will be ¹ _______ per km.
A Government servant in Pay Level 10 may reimburse hotel room rent up to ¹ ________ per day.
No conveyance allowance shall be admissible unless the average running on duty is more than ________ kilometres.

Where a Government servant who is entitled to travel by his own car is transferred from one station to another and five members of his family accompany him, he is entitled to draw ____ additional road mileages for members of his family.

At places where no specific rates have been prescribed, a Government servant who is entitled to travel by his own car may claim mileage allowance at the rate of ¹ _______ per km if he travels in taxi / his own car.
